offering_description.value: Provides engineering, surveying, and consulting services to developers, utilities, industrial companies, and government agencies. Its teams conduct field surveys and site assessments, design buildings and infrastructure, and support permitting and construction.

primary_services.value: civil and infrastructure engineering; land surveying and geospatial mapping; building systems engineering; environmental consulting and permitting; construction management and inspection

customer_segment.value: B2B: real estate developers, building owners, utilities, energy developers, industrial companies, and mining operators; B2G: municipalities, state transportation departments, and federal agencies

end_markets.value: real estate development and buildings; transportation; power and renewable energy; water and wastewater; mining and industrial facilities

revenue_model.value: project or contract: fixed-price design, surveying, mapping, and construction support assignments; service fees: hourly fees for engineering, fieldwork, and consulting

value_chain_position.value: service provider: turns site data and client requirements into surveys, designs, and construction oversight for private and public clients

geography_served.value: US national: serves clients across the United States through a nationwide office network

specialization.value: related lines: engineering design, surveying and mapping, environmental consulting, and construction support

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct proposals to private clients and competitive procurement for public contracts

regulatory_exposure.value: high: state boards license professional engineers and land surveyors and require firm authorization in many states
